pad.metric: pad_total black rows at coded edges
pad.power: HIGH if coded edges reach glass; ZERO if overscan/ascal crops edges
pad.grabber_need: see top/bottom of coded raster, not only active video island

vernier_phase.beat_count_under_uniform_scale: INVARIANT — number of beats in active region unchanged to first order
vernier_phase.conclusion: Classical beat-count vernier has ~zero power against pure scale. Need either (a) pad/crop absolute edges, (b) absolute fiducial slope vs known source Y, or (c) many-cycle phase ramp (~48 cyc) whose template correlation flips — heavy H.264 risk.

chirp_null.conclusion: Chirp null shift from 475 vs 480 is 1% at the fine end only; not a sharp row-localized feature separable from H.264.

verdict.how: NOT pitch/FFT. USE pad_total 0 vs 5 (primary) and multi-fiducial slope/span (secondary).
verdict.cannot: FFT pitch, beat-count vernier, chirp-null row (all weak or invariant under 1% scale)
verdict.limiting_arithmetic_if_edges_cropped: body span delta 3.13 src rows × (958/480) ≈ 6.3 cap px; 13-fiducial slope z≈12.0 at sigma_centroid_src=0.35 (if z>3, slope works even without edges)
verdict.missed_prediction_on_record: solid-field std≈0.4 under 240-ceiling FAILED on glass (moiré/std~67); correct call was which zone discriminates (period-2), not the signature shape. P=4/8/16 invariant under store_y=py*2 — zero power.
